description: The state of one ingestion run started by workbench_kb_add_documents: PENDING / RUNNING / DONE / FAILED, chunks written, and the error when it failed. Read it when the user asks whether their documents are in yet, or before a search that needs them — don't poll in a loop; ingestion of a few documents takes under a minute. Pass the runId the add-documents call returned.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: workbench_kb_ingestion_status
title: Check an ingestion run
